result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages show the three groups at a glance with the same card grid, a repeated spacing rhythm, and labels aligned to their fields. Headings sit with the settings under them. Neither separates sections mainly by space: each group is a bordered box, and the gaps inside a card are in the same family as the gaps between cards. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages show the three groups as bordered cards, so the gap between sections is smaller than the gaps inside them and the boxes do the separating. B places each section label directly above its first setting. A inserts a description and a rule before the fields, so the heading sits farther from its settings. Labels, descriptions, and stacked controls share a left edge in both, on a repeated spacing rhythm.

passes.notes: Both pages show the three groups at a glance with the same card grid, a repeated spacing rhythm, and labels aligned to their fields. Headings sit with the settings under them. Neither separates sections mainly by space: each group is a bordered box, and the gaps inside a card are in the same family as the gaps between cards.

Both pages show the three groups as bordered cards, so the gap between sections is smaller than the gaps inside them and the boxes do the separating.
